rawContent: A whole nation of women said #MeToo, recounting their most painful experiences, showing proof of harassment, filing cases. Men took them to court. Two years later industries made sure those men are welcomed back. This too will be a blip in India's record of crimes against women.

It's an unbearable tragedy. Would want to hear your thoughts about this Chintan. How to address this as a conversation we must have, acknowledge responsibilities associated with callout, while not forgetting the invaluable role #metoo played in giving platform to so many folx.

This is very important. Even during the #Metoo callouts, the conversation was about accountability, taking charge of one's behaviour, addressing that this sort of trauma is a far common occurrance than thought before, and extending solidarities.
